sections.title: How the documents are arranged
text: Every document that survived is here, under the exemplar it was matched to and in the group it formed with the documents nearest it. Nothing has been removed, merged or renamed to produce this page, and nothing on it was written for you.
The documents themselves are still in /corpus. They have not been moved or copied.

sections.title: What you are being asked
text: Is this arrangement worth writing over? The next step reads each group in full and writes a document about it. It will not start until you say this arrangement is the one you want.
To say so, put this into profile.yaml under arrangementApproved:
That name is this arrangement and no other. If the documents are grouped again, this page gets a new name and you are asked again.
Write down what you actually checked in provenance beside it.
